cycle.doc: Stanford University Common Data Set 2025-2026, C1 (31,609 men + 29,011 women + 26 unknown applied; 1,162 + 1,140 admitted; 945 + 894 enrolled)

scores.doc: CDS 2025-2026, C9 (1,022 SAT submitters, 385 ACT submitters)

testPolicy.text: ACT or SAT scores are required; applicants self-report their highest scores and enrolling students send official scores. English proficiency tests cannot replace the ACT/SAT.
testPolicy.since: applications for fall 2026 entry (CDS 2025-26 C8F: 'Stanford reinstated its standardized testing requirement beginning with applications for Fall 2026 entry')

cost.totalIncludes: Standard undergraduate budget, three quarters: tuition 67,731 + housing and food 22,944 + student fees allowance 2,610 (includes the mandatory 843 Campus Health Service Fee plus typical house dues, technology, activities, PO box and course materials fees) + books and supplies 855 + personal 3,405. Travel varies and is not in the total. New students also pay a 525 orientation fee and a 250 document fee.

aidPromise.text: For parents with total annual income below $100,000 and typical assets, Stanford expects no parent contribution toward educational costs (students still contribute from summer and term-time work and savings). For parents with income below $150,000 and typical assets, the expected parent contribution is low enough that all tuition charges are covered by need-based aid. Home equity and retirement accounts are not counted as assets.

facts.text: Stanford reinstated required SAT or ACT scores starting with applications for fall 2026 entry; the fall 2025 class (55.6% SAT submitters) applied test optional.

Restrictive Early Action bars applying early to any other private US college (even MIT's non-binding Early Action) and to any public university's binding plan; students denied in REA cannot reapply in Regular Decision.
Families with income below $100,000 and typical assets pay no parent contribution, and below $150,000 all tuition is covered.
The 2026-27 standard budget is $97,545 before travel, on a quarter calendar (Autumn, Winter, Spring).
For fall 2025, Stanford offered 669 applicants a waiting-list place; 573 accepted and 57 were admitted.

notes: CDS 2025-26 is hosted on Google Drive, linked from https://irds.stanford.edu/data-findings/cds (link read in Chrome; the IRDS page is behind SAML for curl).
